amaysim.status: Supports physical SIM to eSIM and eSIM transfer
amaysim.instructions:
PHYSICAL SIM TO eSIM
1. Open the amaysim app and swipe up to show plan details.
2. Select Replace SIM.
3. Choose I want a replacement eSIM, then Continue.
4. Confirm device compatibility and select Confirm replacement.
5. Confirm your number and select Yes, let’s go.
6. Complete multi-factor authentication.
7. Select OK and wait for SIM replacement.
8. Download the eSIM to the device, confirm it is the right device, and select yes, set it up.
9. Allow the eSIM installation prompts, including the Optus eSIM prompt.
10. Finish setup and select start using my eSIM in the app.
Your old SIM can be used until confirmation arrives, usually in 1–3 hours.

 eSIM TO eSIM
1. Ensure the new phone is on Wi-Fi.
2. Install the amaysim app on the phone receiving the eSIM.
3. Open the eSIM/settings/account-management area and choose set up or transfer eSIM.
4. Follow the app instructions.

Belong.status: Supports physical SIM to eSIM and eSIM transfer
Belong.instructions:
APP METHOD
1. In the Belong app, select Manage mobile plan for the service.
2. Select Move to a new SIM > Swap to eSIM.
3. Enter the code sent to the mobile (valid for 1 hour).
4. Tap Continue with Belong app, then Start installing eSIM.
5. On the Activate New eSIM pop-up, tap Allow, then Continue.
6. Wait for Activating to change to Connecting to network.
7. Return to Belong app and tap Submit eSIM swap.
8. Wait for confirmation email/SMS and completion email, then restart the device.

WEBSITE METHOD
1. Log in to Belong website and select Manage mobile plan.
2. Select Move to a new SIM > Swap to eSIM.
3. Enter the code sent to the mobile (valid for 1 hour).
4. Choose Install eSIM manually and scan the displayed QR code with the target device.
5. Tap Allow on the Activate New eSIM pop-up, then Continue.
6. Wait for network connection, return to the website and select Check eSIM installation, then Submit eSIM swap.
7. Wait for confirmation and completion email, then restart the device.

2. If the account is verified, use web live chat for a two-factor authentication check.

4. Once verified, MATE completes the swap and emails the eSIM details.

2. Complete an identity check.
3. MATE issues a new eSIM and emails a QR code.
4. Display the QR code on another screen and scan it with the new phone.

2. Select SIM and call settings.
3. For the service, select Swap to eSIM.
4. Sign in and ensure you are using the device receiving the eSIM.
5. Submit the SIM swap and follow prompts to activate.
